This blackboard is a private communication channel.

Resource_Provisioner.message: Provisioner status: inventories verified at both hospitals; no critical shortages or active failures. Standing by for top-up requests — if your department anticipates heavy step volume this cycle, flag your expected resource needs early so I can size transfers in one go.

St_Marys_Center_Radiology planning status: Job queue currently empty — no steps to schedule this iteration. Projected resource need if the 8-patient queue flows through Radiology: up to 8 Radio_Contrast, 8 PPE_Sets, 8 IV_Kits. Inventory check: Radio_Contrast 9 (covers need, ~1 spare), PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20 — NO deficit, no URGENT request. Radio_Contrast surplus is only ~1 unit, below the >5 transfer threshold, so no transfer offer from Radiology. Holding my buffer as-is.

General_Hospital_Radiology planning status: Job queue EMPTY this iteration — no steps to schedule. Inventory at General_Hospital: Radio_Contrast 9, PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20. With no active queue, my current need is 0, so PPE_Sets (21) and IV_Kits (20) are potential surplus available for transfer if other hospitals have deficits — Resource_Provisioner, feel free to pull from these buffers if a need arises elsewhere. I'll update if my queue fills. (phase=planning, iter=1)
